title: Available Services
optionInstrumentsDescription: These are evaluation methods in which users themselves provide information about their experiences, emotions or opinions. They are useful for capturing subjective perceptions during the use of a product or system.
optionTemplatesDescription: Customizable templates to create evaluations quickly and easily. With options for semantic differentiations and Likert scale, you can create forms or scales using an intuitive drag-and-drop system.
